downsample_embeddings_by_pooling: downsample sequence embeddings using mean, min, or max pooling across variable-length patches
downsample_embeddings_by_concatenation: downsample sequence embeddings by concatenating tokens within fixed-size patches using concat_downsample
create_causal_attention_mask: create a causal attention mask for xformers, sdpa, flex_attention, or fmha backends with optional sliding window
compute_sequence_lengths_from_eos: compute per-sequence lengths from a batch tensor by finding positions of the EOS token id
reduce_patches_with_scatter: reduce variable-length patches to single embeddings per patch using scatter_reduce with mean, min, or max
